slice: 7S.3/S3.7 per-extraction memoization of shared loop coedge counts
scope: Avoid rescanning an immutable source loop's coedge ring when several faces reference it, without deduplicating per-face projected loop output or changing cycle reporting.

implementation.cacheLifetime: One extractAcisWireframeImpl invocation; local to the immutable model projection.
implementation.accounting: One maxOutputItems unit is reserved before each new map entry; per-face output rows and cycle guards keep their existing charges. This bounds item count, not allocator bytes or RSS.
implementation.allocationFailure: std::bad_alloc continues through the existing allocationFailure outcome path.

controls.source: Generated in-memory ACIS 21800 SAB controls; no fixture file.

assertions: Every face retains all four loop rows in source order.
Each face retains the same source loop node identities.
Extraction work is below four times the equivalent one-face control, while remaining greater due to per-face output traversal.

controls.eightByEight: Existing shared-cycle projection and work-bound control remains passing.
controls.budgetBoundary: Existing exact maxExtractionWorkUnits admission and one-under ResourceLimit controls remain passing.

evidenceLimits: This optimizes repeated structural coedge-count scans only; it does not suppress legitimate per-face loop output.
The work counter is deterministic work evidence, not a wall-clock benchmark.
The item budget does not bound std::map allocator bytes, allocator metadata, or RSS.
This does not validate a complete B-rep, ACIS semantics, a DWG/DXF producer, a native consumer, or general 3D support.

worktree.reason: The shared worktree has broad pre-existing modifications in the same source, test, and plan files; the slice cannot be safely committed without including unrelated work.
